hypothesis: A deployment-visible frequency route that selects DRP-0.45 only for f0 at or above 24 Hz and otherwise keeps Taylor-8 robustly lowers high-frequency train-only Marmousi error on medium groups excluded from both earlier DRP experiments.
expected_mechanism: The rejected full-band confirmation showed a sign change: small low-frequency regressions but strong improvements from 24 Hz upward. Routing on the known source frequency preserves the formal low-band baseline and applies the lower-band optimized spatial symbol only where dispersion dominates.
one_conceptual_change: Restrict the already fixed DRP-0.45 candidate to a fixed f0 >= 24 Hz route; coefficients, time step, CPML, solver, and metric remain unchanged.

parent_evidence.threshold_selection_rule: The first frequency in the disjoint full-band confirmation at which paired DRP improvement became persistent; frozen before this third-group confirmation.

data_contract.selection: Stable f0 quantiles over f0 >= 24 Hz after excluding every medium group used by the pilot and full-band confirmation, with one record per group.
data_contract.exclusion_semantics: No selected medium group may overlap any excluded source index medium group; all physical sample hashes are recomputed before solving.

confirmation_contract.deployable_route: Use DRP-0.45 when source_f0_hz >= 24.0, otherwise Taylor-8.
confirmation_contract.compute_budget: 48 CPU solves, expected wall time about 20 minutes
confirmation_contract.primary_metric: paired mean relative L2 improvement within the registered routed high-frequency stratum
confirmation_contract.failure_signal: Any promotion gate fails, any nonfinite solve occurs, any digest differs, or any selected medium group overlaps either prior DRP experiment.
confirmation_contract.rollback: Keep Taylor-8 for all frequencies and do not carry the DRP route into a frozen holdout.

prohibited_uses: No validation or test_id wavefield may be read during route confirmation.
No target5 frozen truth may be generated until all deployable algorithm choices and evaluation hashes are frozen.
A passing route result is train-only evidence and cannot establish the 5 percent or 10x target.
